title: Office Administrator
description:
**Admin & Stores Executive — Revogreen Technologies, Pune**

Every battery we ship starts with the right cells, strips and boards arriving on time, being counted correctly and being on record. We are looking for the person who owns that: the stores, the inward and outward paperwork, and the office that keeps a fast-growing factory running.

**About us.** Revogreen Technologies Pvt Ltd designs and manufactures lithium battery packs in Pune for drone, defense and industrial customers. We are a team of about 20 engineers and production staff.

**About the role.** In your first year, success means this: every purchase bill is on record within two days of arrival, our stock count matches the system every month, and no dispatch waits for paperwork. You will be the one person who knows what came in, what went out and where it is.

**What you will do**

* Receive incoming material against purchase orders, check quantity and invoice, and enter it into our ERP the same day.
* Keep the stores organised and the stock record accurate; issue material to production and run the monthly physical count.
* Scan, upload and file every inward purchase invoice; keep outward invoices, delivery challans and e-way bills on record.
* Support dispatch: check packing against the order, prepare documents, and book couriers and transporters together with our sales coordinator.
* Help raise purchase orders and follow up with vendors on delivery dates.
* Run the office: stationery and consumables, housekeeping, small repairs, AMCs, fire extinguisher upkeep and office service vendors.

**What we are looking for**

Required:

* 2+ years in admin, stores, inward or dispatch at a manufacturing or trading company.
* Hands-on experience checking GST tax invoices and GSTINs, and generating or checking e-invoices (IRN) and e-way bills.
* Comfortable with Excel and at least one ERP or accounting software (Tally or similar).
* Careful with numbers and paperwork; you notice when a quantity, rate or GSTIN does not match.
* Any graduate degree.

Preferred:

* Experience in electronics, electrical or battery manufacturing.
* Has shipped lithium batteries or other dangerous goods by courier or air.
* Comfortable in English, Hindi and Marathi.

Pay: ₹22,000.00 - ₹30,000.00 per month

* Paid sick time
* Paid time off

Job Title: **Executive Assistant to Managing Director**  
Location: Pune  
Employment Type: Full-Time  
Experience Level: 8 - 12 Years

**About the Role**

We are seeking an experienced, high-ownership, and strategically minded Executive Assistant to Managing Director (EA to MD) with 8 to 12 years of multi-functional experience. In this role, you will act as a strategic partner and force multiplier to senior leadership. You will bridge strategy and execution across key business verticals—including Sales, Marketing, Supply Chain, Logistics, HR, and Customer Experience. Beyond executive operations, you will actively own and drive digital marketing strategies, content creation, brand positioning, and cross-functional growth projects.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Digital Marketing & Growth Strategy

Lead and oversee digital marketing campaigns across Meta, Google Ads, SEO/SEM, and influencer networks to drive D2C customer acquisition and retain subscription users. Partner with growth teams and agencies to optimize Performance Marketing spend, ROAS, Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC), and Customer Lifetime Value (LTV). Direct email marketing campaigns, WhatsApp Business automation, push notifications, and app-based loyalty/retention workflows.

* Content Writing & Strategic Communication

Draft compelling copy for website, mobile app landing pages, product announcements, email newsletters, and promotional messaging. Own corporate communications, founder branding content (LinkedIn posts, industry thought leadership, media releases), and internal newsletter communications. Review, refine, and maintain brand voice across all digital touchpoints, customer communication channels, and packaging/collateral copy.

* Strategic Business Operations & Cross-Functional Governance

Act as a key strategic liaison between the Founder/Leadership and department heads (Logistics, Sales, Warehouse, Finance, Marketing, HR) to align project deliverables and monitor operational workflows. Track company-wide OKRs/KPIs, ensure accountability across business units, and follow up proactively on critical corporate initiatives and milestone deliverables. Lead high-priority ad-hoc strategic projects, market expansion studies, product launch readiness reviews, and process optimization initiatives.

Consolidate daily, weekly, and monthly operational, sales, and financial performance metrics into actionable business intelligence dashboards and MIS reports. Prepare high-level strategic decks, investor presentations, board meeting materials, and executive summaries (PowerPoint/Excel). Analyze operational bottlenecks, unit economics, and last-mile delivery efficiencies to recommend actionable business improvements.

Manage complex schedules, prioritize appointments, organize leadership calendar, and ensure smooth daily time management for senior leadership. Lead executive and cross-departmental reviews, document Minutes of Meetings (MoM) with clear owners, and rigorously track actionable points to closure. Oversee executive communications, confidential records management, and strategic correspondence.

* Experience: 8–12 years of progressive experience in Founder’s Office, Strategy & Operations, Brand/Digital Marketing, or Business Management roles. Prior experience in FMCG, Dairy, D2C, E-commerce, or Food & Beverage is strongly preferred.
* Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Management, Commerce, or Strategic Communications.
* Digital & Marketing Savvy: Solid understanding of performance marketing channels, D2C sales funnels, SEO/SEM, content strategy, and digital consumer engagement.
* Analytical & Technical Skills: High proficiency in Advanced Excel, PowerPoint, Google Workspace, and MIS/data analytics frameworks.
* Communication & Copywriting: Exceptional written and verbal communication skills with a proven ability to write compelling copy and interface smoothly with senior stakeholders.
* Leadership & Ownership: Proven ability to manage cross-functional teams, push projects across the finish line, and operate with high autonomy, confidentiality, and sound business judgment.

title: Assistant Manager - Inventory
description:
**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* **Stock Accuracy and Control**

* Conduct daily cycle counts and monthly/quarterly full stock counts at the warehouse.
* Identify and resolve system vs. physical stock discrepancies; post approved ERP adjustments with appropriate reason codes.
* Track damaged inventory, plant mortality, and expiry; ensure timely movement of stock to bad inventory.
* Ensure accurate and timely GRC (Goods Receipt Confirmation) and verify short/excess receipts against purchase orders (POs).
* **Stock Planning and Cover Days**

* Track DRR (Daily Run Rate) and cover days by SKU on a daily basis.
* Categorise and flag SKUs by priority:
  + P1: 15 days or less
  + P2: 30 days or less
  + P3: 46 days or less
  + Excess stock: Above 46 days
* Plan stock transfers from Talegaon to branch warehouses based on demand and stock availability.
* Evaluate inter-warehouse transfer options before raising new purchase requirements.
* Share stock requirements with the Purchase team and Pune Production team for in-house products.
* **Bundles, BOM and Corporate Orders**

* Maintain the bundle master (BOM) and convert bundle sales into component-level stock requirements.
* Plan inventory for corporate gifting and seasonal/festival orders, including Diwali hampers and add-on products.
* **Slow-Moving and Dead Stock**

* Conduct monthly ABC and FMS (Fast-Moving, Medium-Moving, Slow-Moving) analysis.
* Plan liquidation, stock recalls from stores, and inventory rebalancing across branch warehouses and retail stores.
* **Reports, SOPs and Team Management**

* Prepare daily and monthly MIS reports covering stock summaries, cover days, ageing, stock value, and shrinkage.
* Develop and implement inventory SOPs for receiving, put-away, stock counting, transfers, and returns.
* Guide and train inventory executives at Talegaon and monitor their daily work.

description:
**Sales and Account Executive – Fabrication & Powder Coating**

**Location:** Embross Systems Pvt. Ltd, Pune, India  
**Department:** Sales / Business Development  
**Reports To:** Plant Manager  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time

**Who are We**

At Embross, we build technology that quietly powers millions of travels experience every day. From check-in to boarding, there’s a strong chance that our hardware or software played a role in getting passengers where they need to go.

We partner with some of the world’s leading airlines and airports to deliver passenger automation and self-service solutions that make travel faster, simpler, and less stressful. For our partners, that means more efficient operations and better passenger experience. For us, it means solving complex, real-world challenges on a global scale.

What makes Embross unique is the breadth of what we do. We work across a diverse stack that blends hardware, software, and real-time systems in some of the busiest and most demanding environments in the world. It’s a space where creativity, engineering, and operational thinking come together.

If you’re motivated by meaningful problems, tangible impact, and the opportunity to shape how people move through the world, we should talk.

**What You'll Do**

We are looking for a motivated and results-oriented **Sales and Account Executive** to develop and grow our external customer business for our manufacturing facility in India.

Our plant currently supports the fabrication and powder coating requirements for our own passenger automation and self-service solutions. As part of our growth strategy, we are expanding these capabilities to serve external customers across various industries.

The successful candidate will be responsible for identifying potential customers, developing new business opportunities, visiting prospective clients, understanding their fabrication and finishing requirements, coordinating internally on quotations and feasibility, and converting opportunities into long-term customer relationships.

This is a hands-on B2B sales role that requires significant customer interaction, local market development, and regular travel to meet prospective and existing customers.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Business Development & Sales**

* Identify and develop new business opportunities for:
  + Sheet-metal fabrication
  + Metal cabinets and enclosures
  + Custom fabricated components
  + Powder coating and finishing services
  + Self service solutions on the domestic market, as a second phase.
  + Other related manufacturing capabilities offered by the plant

  

* Research and identify potential customers across relevant industries and geographic markets.
* Build and maintain a strong pipeline of prospective customers.
* Conduct regular cold calls, emails, LinkedIn outreach, networking, and in-person visits to generate new opportunities.
* Schedule and conduct meetings with prospective customers to understand their requirements.
* Visit customer facilities to understand their manufacturing, fabrication, finishing, quality, and delivery requirements.
* Prepare and deliver company and capability presentations to prospective customers.
* Follow up consistently with prospects and move opportunities through the sales cycle from initial contact to order placement.
* Develop relationships with purchasing managers, engineering teams, operations managers, plant managers, and business owners.

**Customer & Account Management**

* Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned customers.
* Develop strong, long-term relationships with customers and identify opportunities for repeat and additional business.
* Understand customer requirements, specifications, volumes, timelines, and quality expectations.
* Coordinate with internal teams to ensure customer requirements are clearly understood and properly communicated.
* Monitor customer satisfaction and proactively address issues or concerns.
* Identify opportunities to increase business with existing customers.

**Quotation & Order Coordination**

* Work closely with the Plant, Engineering, Production, and Finance teams to develop competitive quotations.
* Gather necessary technical and commercial information from customers for quotation purposes.
* Coordinate customer drawings, specifications, quantities, materials, finishing requirements, and delivery expectations.
* Follow up on quotations and negotiate pricing and commercial terms within approved guidelines.
* Support the transition of new customers/orders from sales into production.
* Track orders and communicate status updates to customers as required.

**Market Development**

* Identify industries and customer segments that could benefit from our fabrication and powder-coating capabilities.
* Develop a target customer list and territory strategy.
* Monitor market trends, competitor activity, pricing, and customer requirements.
* Attend relevant trade shows, industry events, networking events, and customer meetings to generate business.
* Continuously identify new applications and markets for the company's manufacturing capabilities.

**Reporting & Sales Planning**

* Maintain accurate records of prospects, opportunities, quotations, orders, and customer interactions.
* Provide regular sales pipeline and business development reports to management.
* Establish and work toward monthly, quarterly, and annual sales targets.
* Track conversion rates, sales activity, customer acquisition, and revenue growth.
* Provide management with market feedback and recommendations regarding pricing, capabilities, and potential new services.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

Success in this position will be measured by:

* Number of qualified new prospects developed.
* Number of customer visits and meetings.
* Number and value of quotations generated.
* New customers acquired.
* Revenue generated from external customers.
* Gross margin generated from new business.
* Conversion of prospects into customers.
* Repeat business and customer retention.
* Growth of the external fabrication and powder-coating business.

**Qualifications & Experience**

* Bachelor's degree or diploma in Business, Sales, Engineering, Manufacturing, or a related field preferred.
* 5+ years of B2B sales/business development experience, preferably in a manufacturing or industrial environment.
* Experience selling one or more of the following would be highly desirable:
  + Sheet-metal fabrication
  + Metal enclosures/cabinets
  + CNC/laser cutting, bending, welding or related fabrication

title: Purchase Executive
description:
**ABOUT ADVISTA TECHNOSOLUTIONS**

Advista Technosolutions Pvt. Ltd. is a **Pune-based engineering services company** specialising in Industrial Instrumentation, Process Automation, and Turnkey Engineering Projects. Founded by an engineer with 20+ years of domain expertise, we serve **100+ clients across India and internationally** (UAE, Sri Lanka, Trinidad & Tobago, Vietnam). We are MSME Udyam Registered, DPIIT Recognised Startup, and SC-ST Hub Honoured by the Ministry of MSME.

We are a small, growing team at an exciting inflection point. The person joining in this role will work directly with the founder in a hands-on environment where **initiative, accuracy, and ownership** are valued above all else.

**ROLE OVERVIEW**

This is a **dual-function role** combining **Accounts & Invoicing** with **Purchase & Vendor Management.** The Executive will handle the complete order-to-invoice cycle on the accounts side, and the enquiry-to-dispatch cycle on the purchase side. Both functions operate simultaneously — this role is suited for a candidate who is **organised, fast-paced, and comfortable with numbers, vendor communication, and documentation.**

*This is not a split role. Both functions are active daily. The ideal candidate treats both with equal ownership.*

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**PURCHASE & VENDOR MANAGEMENT RESPONSIBILITIES**

* **Purchase Lead Register** on the same day of receipt without exception
* Check the internal rate/vendor database before floating any enquiry externally — mandatory first step for every new enquiry
* Float purchase enquiries to a minimum of 2 relevant vendors within 4 working hours if rates are unavailable in the database; ensure complete technical inputs are shared with vendors
* **24–48 hours** of receiving the enquiry — this is a non-negotiable TAT
* **Weboo workflow** on the same day; keep Biziverse CRM in sync with order status
* **Purchase Orders (POs)** on the confirmed vendor within 1 working day of sales confirmation — correct specifications, price, delivery date, and payment terms
* Take structured weekly follow-ups with vendors on all open POs until material is physically received at Advista — log every follow-up in Weboo
* **Monday Order Status Updates** to the sales executive by 12:00 PM every Monday covering all open orders — real-time, accurate information
* On material receipt: verify material against PO (quantity, specification, make); verify all associated documents (invoice, test report, calibration certificate) on the same day
* Ensure received material is inspected for damage and repacked securely before dispatch
* Arrange appropriate courier or transport for dispatch as per client requirement and urgency — within committed dispatch date and approved cost limits
* **Client Dispatch Intimation** on the same day of dispatch — email + WhatsApp with all three: Tax Invoice, material photographs, and courier docket/tracking number

**WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR**

**Required Qualifications & Experience**

* B.Com / M.Com / BBA or equivalent graduate; commerce background preferred
* 1 – 3 years of hands-on work experience in accounts and/or purchase in an engineering, manufacturing, or industrial trading company
* Biziverse ERP — training provided on joining; strong preference for candidates with any ERP/accounting software background; basic accounting concepts (journal entries, GST invoicing) are mandatory
* Microsoft Excel and Word — working proficiency; able to maintain registers, prepare statements, and format documents
* Basic working knowledge of GST (invoice format, HSN codes, GSTR-1 data); TDS awareness is a plus
* Comfortable with vendor communication over email and WhatsApp in a professional manner
* Marathi and Hindi fluency required; basic written English for email communication

**Key Behavioural Attributes We Value**

* **Ownership mindset:** treats both accounts and purchase as their own department — does not wait to be reminded
* **Accuracy over speed:** checks before submitting; zero tolerance for invoice errors or wrong POs
* **Discipline with deadlines:** Monday updates go out on Monday; invoices go out on dispatch day; no exceptions
* **Proactive communication:** updates the manager on delays before the manager asks
* **Adaptability:** comfortable switching between accounts work in the morning and vendor follow-ups in the afternoon — this is a multi-task role
* **Growth orientation:** willing to learn new tools (Weboo, Biziverse CRM) and take on additional responsibilities as the company grows

**This Role Is NOT a Fit If You...**

* Have only done data entry with no ownership of the full accounts or purchase cycle
* Are looking for a work-from-home or flexible-hours arrangement — this is a full-time on-site role
* Are not comfortable with direct vendor and client communication
* Expect a large team and dedicated IT support — we are a lean, growing company

title: Principal Enablement Experience Consultant - India
description:
**We're looking for a**

**Principal Enablement Experience Consultant - India**
======================================================

**This role is** **Office Based, Pune Office**

Job Description | Product Manager & Architect, Enablement Experience

Location: India / In Person Team: Cornerstone University

  

**About Cornerstone:**

At Cornerstone, we believe in AI that works in the service of people, amplifying their judgment to drive high-performing, future-ready organizations forward. Cornerstone Workforce AI™, the intelligence platform for workforce readiness, brings together workforce and labor market data into a proprietary Cornerstone People Graph™, translating signals into intelligence, targeting learning where it matters, developing critical skills, and surfacing hidden talent. Delivered as an open, enterprise platform across whatever application your people work in every day, Cornerstone Workforce AI is built for scale, security, and trust, with certified AI guardrails. As an industry leader, Cornerstone is helping approximately 7,000 organizations, 140M+ users, across 186 countries build continuous workforce readiness.

  

**About the role:**

Today, our customers and partners learn through Cornerstone University training and courses, our knowledge base, live events, community forums, certifications, and conversations with their Customer Success team. These experiences are centralized through the Cornerstone Community, but they live in separate systems and can feel like separate journeys.

As Product Manager & Architect, Enablement Experiences, you will define and own the enablement platforms vision, strategy, architecture, and execution for one unified Cornerstone University experience: a single front door where customers, partners, and employees find answers, connect with experts and peers, learn in the flow of their work, and prove what they can do. You’ll see where information flows, where it breaks, and where the opportunities are, and you’ll turn that into a roadmap, an architecture, and shipped experiences that drive customer adoption, partner readiness, and renewal.

This is a senior, high-ownership role: one part product leader, one part architect, one part builder. You’ll report to the leader of Enablement & Community Experiences, who owns the business outcomes for the function. You own the platform that delivers them. You’ll also act as Customer Zero for Cornerstone’s own Workforce AI and learning technology, running our education business on our own products and feeding what we learn back to Product.

The role joins Cornerstone at an exciting moment, helping shape the company’s future through our Workforce AI tools. This is a new role on the Cornerstone University team for someone with clear vision, sound judgment, and the cross-functional leadership to bring bold ideas to life.

This role is based in India, with teammates based in global geographic hubs. Weekday hours require flexing to provide overlap with members in EMEA and the Americas.

  

**Scope and Decision Rights:**

* **You own:** Cornerstone University product roadmap; prioritization; target-state architecture and standards; integrations and data flows; design and build of AI-powered experiences; build-vs-buy recommendations and vendor evaluations; technical direction for learning system administrators.
* **You partner on:** enablement and community strategy, program priorities, budget, and executive alignment, content (Learning Design & Content) measurement and insights (Strategy, Insights & Operations); identity and security (IT and Security); CRM and customer health data (Salesforce and Gainsight teams).
  

**In this role, you will…**

**Key Responsibilities:**

*Platform Vision, Strategy & Product Management*

* Define and own the platform vision and multi-year roadmap for the Cornerstone University ecosystem (learning platforms, community, knowledge base, certifications, events, in-product learning, and AI experiences), tied directly to customer adoption and retention, partner readiness, and education as a growth function.
* Map the current customer learning landscape, including platforms, data flows, identity, content, search, and handoffs, and identify where users hit friction, fragmentation, duplication, or unnecessary cost.
* Run continuous product discovery with customers, partners, Customer Success, Services, and Support. Prioritize by business impact and say no clearly.
* Lead build vs. buy vs. partner decisions and platform vendor strategy, backed by business cases. Evaluate vendor roadmaps and market shifts in customer education and community platforms.
* Present the platform roadmap, investment cases, and trade-offs to executives in clear business language.

*Architecture & Standards*

* Define the target-state architecture and standards for the learning ecosystem, including data models, integration patterns, identity and SSO design, content and search, and security and privacy. Partner with Product, IT, and Security to put them into practice.
* Own the shared taxonomy and metadata framework covering products, skills, roles, audiences, and content types, as the foundation for search, personalized learning paths, reporting, and AI retrieval.
* Instrument the ecosystem: define event-level learning telemetry (e.g., xAPI and a learning record store) and data pipelines so learning, community, and certification activity can be measured at account and capability level and connected to adoption, retention, and revenue.
* Ensure the experience is accessible, localized, and performs well for a global audience.

*AI-Powered Experiences*

* Lead the strategy, design, and build of AI-powered experiences across Cornerstone University and Community, such as an authenticated answer experience that blends learning, community, and support content; personalized learning paths and nudges; and AI-assisted practice and assessment. Use native Cornerstone AI first and third-party solutions where justified.
* Own the retrieval approach behind these experiences, including retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) over a governed content corpus, permission-aware retrieval, and content freshness, working closely with Content and Product teams.
* Establish evaluation and responsible AI practices: accuracy and hallucination testing, guardrails, human-in-the-loop review, privacy, and cost monitoring.
* Design for an agentic future, including integration through emerging standards such as the Model Context Protocol (MCP) and partner agent ecosystems.

*Integration & Execution*

* Own and drive the integrations between the learning ecosystem including Cornerstone platform, Salesforce and Gainsight so learning, community, and certification data syncs to the right account and contact records and appears in Customer Success, Sales, and partner workflows, giving a complete picture of adoption, health, and renewal.
* Lead delivery of platform programs end to end: plans, milestones, dependencies, risks, vendor and implementation-partner management, testing, launch, and change management.
* Own the certification and credentialing platform infrastructure, including proctored exams, digital badges, and certification maintenance and renewal flows, in partnership with the Certification team.
* Deliver learning in the flow of work, including in-product guidance within Cornerstone and experiences embedded in the tools customers, partners, and employees already use.
* Set technical priorities for learning system administrators, review configuration decisions, evaluate platform changes, and define release and testing standards.

*Partnership & Leadership*

* Partner with your manager to translate business goals into platform priorities and to report progress and outcomes.
* Work across Cornerstone University, Customer Success, Services, Support, Alliances, Product, Marketing, and IT.
* Act as Customer Zero: run Cornerstone University on Cornerstone products and give structured feedback to Product.
* Explain technical trade-offs clearly to non-technical stakeholders and executives.
  

**What Success Looks Like:**

* **First 30-60 days:** current-state map, target-state architecture, prioritized roadmap, and investment case agreed with leadership; quick wins identified and underway.
* **By 6 months:** unified identity and single front door in delivery; agentic experiences serving 60+% of the audience’s needs through agentic front door, learning and community data flowing to Salesforce and Gainsight account records at an agreed data-quality level; telemetry standards in place; first AI experience piloting with defined success metrics.
* **By 9-12 months:** single front door live for customers and partners serving 80+% of the needs; AI answer experience in production with measured resolution and satisfaction; fewer platforms and lower platform cost; learning engagement visible in account health and used by Customer Success; certification infrastructure supporting proctored, role-based credentials at scale.
* **Ongoing measures:** front-door adoption, time to answer, integration reliability, data quality, AI resolution rate, and platform cost, plus clear contribution to customer adoption, retention, and partner readiness.

**You've Got What It Takes If You Have…**

**Required Skills & Experience:**

* 10+ years in learning technology, customer education, or enterprise SaaS platforms, including significant time as a platform owner, product manager, or architect who set strategy, not only configured tools.
* Proven ownership of a multi-platform learning ecosystem. You were accountable for the vision, architecture, integrations, and roadmap across learning, community, knowledge, and certification platforms, with evidence that it improved customer and business outcomes.
* Product management depth: discovery, prioritization, road mapping, business cases, build vs. buy decisions, and adoption metrics.
* A track record of leading large-scale, multi-system implementations or consolidations from strategy through delivery, including vendors and cross-functional teams.
* Deep integration experience across learning systems and Salesforce CRM, including REST APIs, webhooks, middleware, SSO (SAML/OIDC), data syncs, and learning standards (SCORM, xAPI, cmi5, LTI).
* Hands-on expertise with at least one enterprise or customer education LMS, preferably Cornerstone, or Skilljar, Docebo, Thought Industries, Intellum, Absorb, or similar.
* AI shipped in production: you have designed and delivered at least one AI-powered experience (e.g., agents, RAG-based answers, or AI workflows) used by real users with measured outcomes, and can speak to evaluation, guardrails, data governance, and cost.
* Ability to set strategy independently and communicate it at executive level.
* Comfort moving between strategy and configuration in the same day.
  

**Strongly Preferred:**

* Experience integrating online community platforms (Gainsight preferred), including SSO, data, and how learning and community intersect.
* Experience with Gainsight or similar customer success platforms and customer health data.
* Customer and partner education experience at a B2B SaaS company, including certification programs.
* Experience with agent interoperability standards (such as MCP) and enterprise AI platforms.
* Salesforce certifications (Administrator, Platform App Builder, or Integration Architect).
  

**How You Work:**

* **Customer obsessed:** you start from the learner’s and the account’s problem, not the tool.
* **Innovate and transform:** you challenge the status quo and retire systems and processes that don’t earn their place.
* **Proactive leadership:** you see the problem and act before you’re asked.
* **Get it done:** you ship, measure, and iterate.
* **Forward looking:** you plan for where the technology and the business are going, not where they have been.
* **AI native:** you use AI every day to rethink your own work, not just to speed it up.
* **Get uncomfortable to succeed:** you take on hard, ambiguous problems and stay with them.
  

#LI-Onsite

**Our Culture:**

Spark Greatness. Shatter Boundaries. Share Success. Are you ready? Because here, right now – is where the future of work is happening. Where curious disruptors and change innovators like you are helping communities and customers enable everyone – anywhere – to learn, grow and advance. To be better tomorrow than they are today.

**Who We Are:**

At Cornerstone, we believe in AI that works in the service of people, amplifying their judgment to drive high-performing, future-ready organizations forward. Cornerstone Workforce AI™, the intelligence platform for workforce readiness, brings together workforce and labor market data into a proprietary Cornerstone People Graph™, translating signals into intelligence, targeting learning where it matters, developing critical skills, and surfacing hidden talent. Delivered as an open, enterprise platform across whatever application your people work in every day, Cornerstone Workforce AI is built for scale, security, and trust, with certified AI guardrails. As an industry leader, Cornerstone is helping approximately 7,000 organizations, 140M+ users, across 186 countries build continuous workforce readiness.

description:
**Job Description**

**Pipeline & Market Intelligence Manager**

**Job title**

Pipeline & Market Intelligence Manager

**Location**

Pune, India

Marketing Director

Office-based

Competitive

**About Optimas International**

Optimas International is a global specialist in engineering and industrial distribution, providing fastener distribution and supply chain solutions to manufacturers across the UK, Europe, India and South East Asia, and China. We are entering a period of focused growth, built around six priority global verticals, our existing customer base in each country, and a programme of acquisitions.

To deliver that growth we are building a strong central marketing function with the skills and discipline to generate leads, control the pipeline and give the business clear visibility of new wins. This role sits at the centre of that function.

**About the role**

This is a Revenue Operations role in all but name. You will own the master global pipeline in HubSpot: what goes into it, how accurate it is, and how actively it is worked. You will lead a small research team that identifies new opportunities, and you will hold regional sales and business development teams to account for working those opportunities through to a clear outcome.

It is not a research-only or administrative position. We are looking for a senior, commercially minded operator who is equally comfortable building a reporting framework, challenging a sales leader on stale pipeline, and presenting findings to senior management.

**Purpose**

Control the master pipeline. Own the report-out of leads per vertical and per region, feed HubSpot, and remain accountable for the accuracy of active leads in the system. Hold sales teams in every region to account for pipeline activity and data accuracy.

**Key responsibilities**

**Pipeline control and HubSpot ownership**

* Own the master global target file in HubSpot, combining strategic targets, regional targets and newly identified leads into a single source of truth.
* Maintain a live queue of 10 to 20 active leads per region, ensuring that as one opportunity closes or is lost, the next qualified lead is brought into play.
* Own the report-out of leads by vertical and region, and the process that feeds them into HubSpot.
* Define and enforce pipeline stages, qualification criteria and data standards, working with the external HubSpot consultant, who owns technical build, automation and system configuration.

**Sales accountability and compliance**

* Hold regional business development teams and P&L leads accountable for HubSpot workflow compliance, pipeline activity and data accuracy across the UK, Europe, India and South East Asia, and APAC.
* Run regular pipeline reviews with regional sales teams, challenging inactive or poorly qualified opportunities and agreeing clear next actions.
* Escalate persistent non-compliance constructively and with evidence, working with the Marketing Director and senior sales leadership.

**Market intelligence and research leadership**

* Direct two Research Analysts covering the six global verticals (three verticals each) to identify and qualify new targets.
* Direct one Research Analyst focused on cross-sell, share-of-wallet and global account plant mapping: identifying where an existing global customer has manufacturing sites in regions we do not yet serve.
* Own communication of research findings and market intelligence to sales leads and the Marketing Manager and regional Marketing Executives, so the business stays on the front foot in every region.
* Provide a regular market intelligence and topic feed to the Communications and Brand team to inform content and campaigns.

**Reporting and performance**

* Produce clear, consistent pipeline reporting by region and vertical for the Marketing Director and senior leadership.
* Work with the BI and data governance team, who own dashboards, win reporting and board reporting, to ensure definitions and data are consistent across all regions.
* Support marketing performance reporting by linking campaign and digital lead generation activity to pipeline outcomes.

**Key relationships**

* **Internal:** Marketing Director, Marketing Manager and regional Marketing Executives, Communications and Brand Manager, regional P&L leads and BD teams, BI and data governance.
* **External:** HubSpot consultant (technical build and governance), data and research providers.

**Skills and experience**

**Essential**

* Demonstrable significant experience in revenue operations, sales operations, pipeline management or a closely related commercial function, including at least 3 years in a management role.
* Proven track record of owning a CRM pipeline end to end and driving adoption and compliance across a sales organisation.
* Strong hands-on HubSpot experience (or Salesforce or Dynamics with clear evidence of rapid transfer to HubSpot).
* Demonstrable experience of holding sales teams and senior stakeholders to account, including across multiple countries and cultures.
* Experience leading and developing analysts or researchers, setting priorities and quality standards.
* Highly analytical, with advanced Excel skills and confidence building pipeline and performance reporting.
* B2B experience, ideally in industrial, manufacturing, engineering or distribution markets with long, complex sales cycles.

**Desirable**

* HubSpot certifications (for example Sales Hub or Revenue Operations).
* Experience of market research, account-based marketing or target account mapping.
* Familiarity with BI tools such as Power BI.
* Experience integrating acquired businesses into a central pipeline and reporting framework.
* Degree in business, marketing, economics or a related discipline, or equivalent experience.
* Experience working with UK and European stakeholders.

**Communication requirements**

Communication is central to this role. You will be the person who tells sales teams, in every region, what the pipeline really looks like and what needs to happen next.

* Highly proficient written and spoken English is essential. You will write reports, pipeline summaries and briefings for senior UK and international stakeholders, and these must be clear, accurate and professional without editing.
* Excellent and confident verbal communicator, able to lead calls and meetings with UK, European and APAC sales teams and senior leaders, and to hold your position under challenge.
* Comfortable working across time zones, with a regular overlap with UK working hours.
* Able to turn complex data into clear, concise messages and actions.

**Personal attributes**

* Assertive and resilient, with the credibility to challenge senior sales colleagues constructively.
* Commercially curious, with a genuine interest in markets, customers and where growth will come from.
* Highly organised, with strong attention to detail and a disciplined approach to data.
* A collaborative leader who builds trust across functions and regions.
* Self-motivated and comfortable operating with a high degree of autonomy in a growing business.

**Measures of success**

* A complete, accurate and current master pipeline in HubSpot, trusted by sales and leadership.
* 10 to 20 qualified active leads maintained per region at all times.
* High HubSpot workflow compliance across all regional BD teams.
* Steady growth in new targets identified across the six verticals and in cross-sell plant opportunities.
* Timely, consistent pipeline reporting delivered to agreed standards.

**Working arrangements**

This role is based in Pune, India, and works UK hours to align with the Marketing, Communications and Brand team and colleagues in the UK and Europe.

title: Estimation Engineer
description:
# JOB DESCRIPTION

## Estimation Engineer / Estimation Executive

\*\*Company:\*\* Vasu Infosec Limited

\*\*Department:\*\* Estimation / Pre-Sales / Tendering

\*\*Designation:\*\* Estimation Engineer / Estimation Executive

\*\*Location:\*\* Pune

\*\*Employment Type:\*\* Full-Time

\*\*Reporting To:\*\* Estimation / Tendering Manager

### 1. Job Purpose

The Estimation Engineer / Executive will be responsible for preparing accurate and commercially viable project estimates, BOQs, cost sheets and quotations for \*\*Fire & Safety, ELV, Security, and Integrated Systems\*\* projects. The role will involve coordination with the Tendering, Projects, Procurement, OEM/Vendors and Sales teams to ensure technically compliant and commercially competitive submissions.

### 2. Key Responsibilities

\* Study tender documents, RFQs, BOQs, technical specifications, drawings, scope of work and contractual requirements.

\* Prepare detailed \*\*quantity take-offs, BOQs, rate analysis and project cost estimates\*\*.

\* Analyse drawings, layouts, schematics and specifications to identify material and installation requirements.

\* Prepare estimates for systems such as:

\* Fire Detection & Alarm Systems

\* Fire Suppression Systems

\* Water Mist / Gas Suppression Systems

\* CCTV Surveillance Systems

\* Access Control & Biometric Systems

\* Public Address / Voice Evacuation Systems

\* Intrusion Detection Systems

\* ELV & Integrated Security Systems

\* Networking / Structured Cabling

\* Obtain and evaluate quotations from OEMs, suppliers, subcontractors and service providers.

\* Prepare comparative statements for vendor/OEM quotations and identify cost-effective solutions.

\* Verify technical compliance of quoted products against tender specifications.

\* Coordinate with the technical team for \*\*BOQ preparation, quantity verification and system design inputs\*\*.

\* Calculate material, labour, installation, testing & commissioning, transportation and other project-related costs.

\* Incorporate applicable overheads, contingencies, margins, taxes and commercial terms in the final estimation.

\* Prepare detailed \*\*cost sheets, rate analysis, price schedules and commercial offers\*\*.

\* Support preparation of tender BOQs and ensure that no major scope item is omitted.

\* Identify deviations, exclusions, assumptions and potential commercial risks in tender documents.

\* Conduct estimation benchmarking based on previous projects and market rates.

\* Maintain a database of \*\*OEM prices, vendor rates, installation rates and historical project costs\*\*.

\* Coordinate with Procurement for updated material and equipment pricing.

\* Support tender submission by providing timely and accurate commercial inputs.

\* Participate in pre-bid discussions and clarification analysis wherever required.

\* Maintain proper documentation and version control of estimates and commercial submissions.

### 3. Tender & Commercial Responsibilities

\* Analyse \*\*Eligibility Criteria, Technical Qualification Criteria and Scope of Work\*\*.

\* Identify mandatory technical/commercial requirements affecting project costing.

\* Review BOQ quantities against drawings and specifications.

\* Prepare \*\*item-wise rate analysis\*\* and validate rates with market/OEM inputs.

description:
**We're looking for a**

**Director, Product Management - Learning**
===========================================

**This role is** **Office Based, Pune Office**

**Director, Product Management — Learning | Pune |**
  
  
**About Cornerstone**

Cornerstone powers the future of work by helping organizations develop, engage, and grow their people. Our learning and talent platform serves thousands of organizations and millions of learners worldwide, bringing together learning experiences, skills intelligence, content, and analytics so people can build the capabilities their organizations need most. We are investing heavily in the next generation of learning — including AI-assisted, skills-based, and outcome-driven experiences — and we are looking for product leaders who can turn that ambition into products customers love.

**About the Role**

Cornerstone is seeking a Director of Product Management to lead a core area of our Learning product line. This is a senior product leadership role that combines product vision and strategy, people leadership, and disciplined execution. You will own the strategy and roadmap for your area, lead and grow a team of product managers, and be accountable for delivering learning experiences that drive measurable adoption, learner and administrator value, and commercial impact.
  
You will partner across engineering, design, data science, content, customer success, services, sales, and marketing to move capabilities from customer need through discovery, launch, adoption, and outcome realization. The ideal candidate brings deep enterprise SaaS product experience, a strong track record building products that customers adopt and love, and the judgment to balance long-term platform strategy with the operational rigor required to ship. Experience with AI-native and skills-based capabilities is a strong plus — AI is an increasingly central theme across the Learning portfolio.

**In This Role You Will**

**Set vision & strategy**
  
Own the product vision and multi-year roadmap for your area of the Learning portfolio, grounded in market trends, customer needs, and Cornerstone's strategy.
  
Make and defend prioritization decisions with clear rationale, translating strategy into a sequenced roadmap and well-formed bets.
  
Frame the business case for major investments — market sizing, opportunity, and expected outcomes — and align leadership and cross-functional partners behind it.
  
Champion AI and skills-based innovation where it creates real learner and administrator value, integrating intelligent capabilities responsibly into the learning experience.
  
**Lead & grow the team**
  
Hire, coach, and develop a team of product managers, setting a high bar for product craft, customer empathy, and accountability.
  
Establish product standards and operating cadences for discovery, planning, release, and outcome review across your team.
  
Create clarity and alignment across product, engineering, and design leadership, and represent your area to executives and customers.
  
**Discover, experiment & measure**
  
Drive rigorous customer discovery, engaging directly with enterprise customers, learners, and administrators to validate problems and use cases before committing to solutions.
  
Run a hypothesis-driven practice — define success metrics, instrument products, and use experimentation and A/B testing to learn quickly and de-risk decisions.
  
Define and own the success metrics and North Star for your area (adoption, engagement, retention, time-to-value, and business outcomes), and use them to guide investment.
  
Translate customer, field, and market feedback into clear requirements, prioritized backlogs, and release plans.
  
**Deliver with rigor**

title: Senior Specialist Business Consultant (Change Management & Evangelist, AI Incubation)
description:
At NiCE, we don't limit our challenges. We challenge our limits. Always. We're ambitious. We're game changers. And we play to win. We set the highest standards and execute beyond them. And if you're like us, we can offer you the ultimate career opportunity that will light a fire within you.

**Change Management & Evangelist, AI Incubation (SPARK)**
=========================================================

SPARK | CX International Internal Incubation Team | Location: Pune

**So, what's the role all about?**
----------------------------------

NiCE is building SPARK, a new internal incubation team that turns great ideas from across CX International into working AI solutions, and then into enterprise-grade tools that roll out to colleagues around the world. A tool only creates value if people use it, so we need a change leader who can make AI feel useful, safe, and exciting.

As Change Management & Evangelist, you will lead the people side of everything SPARK delivers - preparing teams for change, building AI confidence and skills, and creating the energy that turns a new tool into a new habit. You bring a consulting background, so you know how to diagnose, structure, influence, and deliver, and how to tell a story that moves senior leaders and front-line teams alike.

You will be a visible champion of AI for CX International. You will demo, teach, listen, and bring what you hear back to the builders. You will work closely with the Project Manager, the Business Analyst, the AI Architects & Builders, and the Support Helpdesk, Field Sales Enablement team, HR Business Partners.

**How will you make an impact?**
--------------------------------

You will own adoption for every SPARK solution, from the first conversation with the business through to sustained use at scale and be the voice of SPARK across the organization.

### **Plan and Lead Change**

  

* Assess change impact and readiness for each solution, and map stakeholders, concerns, and the behaviours that need to shift
* Serve as the primary **on-the-ground team leader** for SPARK initiatives, providing hands-on support throughout rollout and adoption phases.
* Build and run change, communications, and rollout plans for each global launch, tailored to regions, roles, and time zones
* Work with the Project Manager so change milestones sit inside the delivery plan, not after it
* Address resistance and concerns openly, including questions about roles and job security, with honest and consistent messages

### **Build AI Fluency and Skills**

* Design and deliver role-based training, workshops, office hours, and self-paced content that teach people to use SPARK solutions in their own workflow
* Create and maintain the SPARK playbook: guides, templates, FAQs, and good-practice examples
* Promote responsible and secure use of AI, in line with company guidance
* Be in constant engagement with key stakeholders and users to identify engagement roadmap

### **Be the Evangelist**

* Tell the SPARK story through demos, showcases, town halls, and internal roadshows that show what is possible and what is already working
* Build and run a network of AI champions across business units who help their peers adopt new tools and share what works
* Collect ideas from across the organisation and encourage colleagues to bring them to SPARK
* Act as a trusted adviser to senior leaders on how to lead their teams through AI-enabled change
* Draft and send communications as required for CX International, ELT as project sponsor working with NiCE Comms team and HR.

### **Measure and Improve Adoption**

* Define adoption and value measures: active use, depth of use, sentiment, behavior change, and benefits realized
* Run feedback loops with users, the Support Helpdesk, and the architects, turning recurring issues and requests into improvements
* Report adoption progress and lessons learned to sponsors, CX International Senior Leadership and steering committees

**Have you got what it takes?**
-------------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in business, Organisational Development, Communications, Technology, or a related field, or equivalent experience
* 12-18 years of experience in change management, transformation, or enablement, including a background in management or technology consulting
* Proven record of leading change for technology rollouts and shifts in ways of working, across multiple regions or business units
* Strong knowledge of structured change approaches such as Prosci ADKAR, Kotter certification, or equivalent
* Excellent storytelling, facilitation, and presentation skills, including with senior executives
* Experience designing and delivering training and enablement programs for non-technical audiences
* Hands-on fluency with generative AI tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, or Copilot, and a practical sense of what they can and cannot do
* Experience in using Notebook LLM, Synthesia, Beautiful.ai or equivalent.
* Ability to influence across teams without direct authority, and to use data to show progress
* Fluency in English

### **You will have an advantage if you also have:**

* Experience in software, SaaS, or technology companies or working for consulting company
* Agentic AI adoption project outside of India is a plus
* Experience running AI or digital champion networks
* Prosci ADKAR or an equivalent change management certification
* Instructional design or learning and development experience
* Experience speaking at internal or external events
* Experience working with teams across APAC, EMEA, and the Americas

**What's in it for you?**
-------------------------

SPARK is a chance to be a founding member of a brand-new team, and to shape how NiCE turns AI ideas into everyday tools used by colleagues around the world.

Join an ever-growing, market-disrupting, global company where the teams, comprised of the best of the best, work in a fast-paced, collaborative, and creative environment! As the market leader, every day at NiCE is a chance to learn and grow, and there are endless internal career opportunities across multiple roles, disciplines, domains, and locations. If you are passionate about AI, innovative at heart, and excited to constantly raise the bar on what intelligent technology can do, you may just be our next NiCEr!

**Enjoy NiCE-FLEX!**
--------------------

At NiCE, we work according to the NiCE-FLEX hybrid model, which enables maximum flexibility: 2 days working from the office and 3 days of remote work, each week. Naturally, office days focus on face-to-face meetings, where teamwork and collaborative thinking generate innovation, new ideas, and a vibrant, interactive atmosphere.

title: Parts Sales (New Aftermarket) - Pune
description:
ROLE PURPOSE
  
The Key Account Manager (KAM) is the dedicated owner of aftermarket revenue and customer relationships for a defined set of strategic accounts that collectively represent a large share of addressable AM revenue in the region. The KAM is the single commercial point of contact at these accounts for spare parts, M-Powered contracts, retrofits and any other new AM offerings, and is responsible for converting whitespace into recurring aftermarket revenue.
  
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
  
Account Ownership & Revenue Growth
  

* Manage assigned strategic accounts end-to-end for all aftermarket revenue streams
* Deliver the assigned account-level AM revenue target across spares, M-Powered, retrofits and new AM products
* Convert whitespaces in assigned regions – identify under-penetrated SKUs, machines and product categories and activate them
* Build and protect Milacron's entitlement value (SOM) capture at each account

Customer Engagement & Coverage
  

* Maintain a structured visit / call plan (PJP) across assigned accounts – minimum weekly customer visits and calls per defined cadence
* Build relationships across plant-level and corporate-level decision-makers (maintenance, procurement, plant heads)
* Handle commercial and service-related escalations in coordination with the Regional Service team (Regional Service Managers and Service Engineers)

Contracting & Upsell
  

* Push Milacron spare part sales, consumable kits, and structured replacement programs
* Drive M-Powered contract closures; build the pipeline at the account level
* Coordinate with Service Engineers to convert any SE-flagged upsell opportunities in their accounts into closed orders

Reporting & Governance
  

* Maintain accurate account, opportunity and visit data in CRM / MIS
* Submit weekly coverage reports and monthly account reviews to the Regional Aftermarket Head

SUCCESS METRICS / KPIS
  
Revenue & Growth Customer Coverage Operational Discipline
  

* Account AM revenue vs. target (primary KPI)
* SOM capture % at assigned customers
* M-Powered penetration in assigned accounts
* Customer visits per week / calls per week (PJP adherence %)
* Customer NPS at assigned accounts
* Whitespace accounts activated
* CRM data hygiene (% complete records)
* On-time submission of weekly / monthly reports

KEY SKILL REQUIREMENTS
  
Skill Dimension What We Are Looking For
  
Technical & Commercial
  

* B2B field sales and account management in capital goods or industrial equipment
* Strong product and spare-parts knowledge (injection moulding preferred)
* Account mining, negotiation and deal closing

Analytics & Planning
  

* Account revenue analysis and visit planning (PJP)
* Sales forecasting and pipeline tracking
* Proficiency in Excel / MIS reporting, CRM and PJP / route-planning tools

Interpersonal
  

* Customer relationship management at plant and corporate levels
* Cross-functional coordination with service teams

Behavioural
  

* Customer-first mindset
* Hunter mentality and self-motivation
* Strong communication skills and resilience

EXPERIENCE PROFILE
  

* 4-5 years of B2B sales / key account management experience in capital goods, industrial equipment or aftermarket
* Demonstrated record of growing account-level revenue and converting whitespace opportunities
* Exposure to spare-parts or aftermarket selling preferred
* Engineering background (Mechanical / Production) preferred

#LI-VU1
  
  
**Who we are:**  
Milacron is a global industrial leader in the manufacturing and distribution of highly engineered and customized injection molding and extrusion solutions, and aftermarket parts and service for the plastics processing industry. The company’s 1,900+ associates worldwide collaborate to serve a diverse range of end-markets, such as automotive, construction, medical, telecommunications, material handling, packaging, and much more. With expertise in plastics spanning nearly 60 years, Milacron holds longstanding relationships with more than 27,000 customers around the world. The original equipment provider of plastics manufacturing solutions is the largest US-owned and globally served of its kind. Headquartered in Batavia, OH, Milacron’s global footprint is also serviced through regional facilities in Asia, Europe, and South America.

Job DescriptionArea Sales Manager (ASM) – Beverage Division

**Department:** Sales & Distribution  
**Designation:** Area Sales Manager (ASM)

**Reporting To:** Regional Sales Manager / Sales Head  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time

About the Role

We are looking for a motivated and result-oriented **Area Sales Manager (ASM)** to lead sales and distribution activities for our beverage portfolio across an assigned territory.

The ASM will be responsible for developing the distribution network, managing distributors and sales representatives, driving secondary and primary sales, expanding retail presence, and ensuring strong visibility of products across the market.

The ideal candidate should have experience in **FMCG, beverages, food products, or consumer goods**, with strong knowledge of general trade and distributor-led sales.

Key Responsibilities1. Sales & Target Achievement

* Achieve monthly, quarterly, and annual sales targets for the assigned territory.
* Develop and execute territory-wise sales plans.
* Drive primary sales to distributors and secondary sales through retail outlets.
* Identify opportunities to increase sales volume, market penetration, and product availability.
* Monitor sales performance against targets and take corrective actions.

2. Distributor Management

* Appoint, develop, and manage distributors across the assigned territory.
* Maintain strong relationships with distributors, super-stockists, and key channel partners.
* Ensure adequate stock availability at distributor points.
* Monitor distributor inventory, billing, collections, and stock movement.
* Coordinate with distributors to improve market coverage and outlet servicing.

3. Market Expansion

* Identify and develop new markets and territories.
* Expand the company's retail network by onboarding new outlets.
* Develop coverage across supermarkets, grocery stores, convenience stores, cafés, restaurants, institutional buyers, and other relevant channels.
* Identify potential distributors and channel partners in uncovered areas.
* Conduct regular market visits to understand competition, pricing, consumer demand, and market trends.

4. Team Management

* Manage and guide Sales Officers, Sales Executives, and field sales representatives.
* Set daily and monthly targets for the sales team.
* Monitor beat plans, outlet coverage, productive calls, and order generation.
* Conduct regular team meetings and market reviews.
* Train the team on products, selling techniques, schemes, and market execution.

5. Retail & Visibility

* Ensure availability of all assigned SKUs at retail outlets.
* Improve product visibility through displays, racks, branding, POSM, and promotional activities.
* Ensure proper execution of company schemes and trade promotions.
* Monitor competitor activities, pricing, promotions, and new product launches.
* Ensure proper FIFO/FEFO stock rotation wherever applicable.

6. Market Intelligence

* Track competitor brands, pricing, schemes, product launches, and distribution strategies.
* Gather feedback from distributors, retailers, and consumers.
* Identify high-potential outlets and emerging market opportunities.
* Prepare regular market and competitor reports for management.

7. Collections & Commercial Control

* Monitor distributor outstanding payments and ensure timely collections.
* Maintain healthy distributor credit and stock levels.
* Coordinate with the finance team regarding outstanding payments and credit limits.
* Minimize expiry, damage, leakage, and slow-moving inventory.

8. Reporting

* Prepare daily/weekly/monthly sales reports.
* Track primary and secondary sales.
* Report distributor-wise and territory-wise performance.
* Submit market visit reports and competitor activity reports.
* Maintain accurate records of outlet coverage, new outlet additions, and sales productivity.

Required Skills

* Strong understanding of **FMCG/beverage sales and distribution**.
* Good knowledge of distributor and retail networks.
* Strong communication and negotiation skills.
* Ability to manage and motivate a field sales team.
* Strong market development and relationship-management skills.
* Target-oriented and commercially driven approach.
* Good analytical and reporting skills.
* Willingness to travel extensively within the assigned territory.
* Basic proficiency in MS Excel, Google Sheets, and sales reporting tools.

Educational Qualification

* Graduate degree in any discipline.
* MBA/PGDM in Sales & Marketing will be an advantage.

Experience

**Preferred:** 2–5 years of experience in FMCG, beverages, food & beverage, or consumer products sales.

Candidates with strong experience in **general trade, distributor management, and territory expansion** will be preferred.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Primary sales achievement
* Secondary sales achievement
* New distributor appointments
* New outlet additions
* Retail outlet coverage
* Numeric distribution
* SKU-wise availability
* Distributor productivity
* Sales team productivity
* Collection efficiency
* Market expansion
* Product visibility and execution
* Reduction in expiry/damage/returns

Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate is a **hands-on field sales professional** who understands how FMCG products move from the company → distributor → retailer → consumer.

The candidate should be comfortable spending significant time in the market, building relationships with distributors and retailers, opening new outlets, managing sales teams, and aggressively expanding the company's presence within the assigned territory.

description:
OpenGov is the leader in AI and ERP solutions for local and state governments in the U.S. More than 2,000 cities, counties, state agencies, school districts, and special districts rely on the OpenGov Public Service Platform to operate efficiently, adapt to change, and strengthen the public trust. Category-leading products include enterprise asset management, procurement and contract management, accounting and budgeting, billing and revenue management, permitting and licensing, and transparency and open data. These solutions come together in the OpenGov ERP, allowing public sector organizations to focus on priorities and deliver maximum ROI with every dollar and decision in sync. Learn about OpenGov’s mission to power more effective and accountable government and the vision of high-performance government for every community at OpenGov.com.

**Job Summary:**
----------------

The Sales Development Representative (SDR), based in Pune, is a dedicated pipeline-generation engine for OpenGov's US go-to-market team. This role is built for outbound specialists who want to master high-volume prospecting into the US public sector market, working US-aligned hours to connect directly with government decision-makers in real time. * Collaborate with marketing by following up on inbound and campaign-generated leads to maximize lead-to-opportunity conversion
* Maintain accurate, up-to-date records in Salesforce for all prospecting activity

**Requirements and Preferred Experience:**
------------------------------------------

* 2 to 4 years of experience in **SDR, Sales** or a customer-facing role
* Excellent spoken and written English, with the confidence to cold-call US-based government decision-makers and quickly build rapport
* Comfortable working US-aligned hours from Pune

**Why OpenGov?**

**A Mission That Matters.**

At OpenGov, public service is personal. We are passionate about our mission to power more effective and accountable government. Government that operates efficiently, adapts to change, and strengthens public trust. Some people say this is boring. We think it’s the core of our democracy.

**A Team of Passionate, Driven People**

**A Place to Make Your Mark**

We pride ourselves on our performance-based culture, where every employee is encouraged to jump in head-first and take action to help us improve. If you have a great idea, we want to hear it. Excellent performance is recognized and rewarded, and we love to promote from within.

title: EY - GDS Consulting -AI Strategy & Go-To-Market
description:
Location: Pune

Other locations: Anywhere in Country

Salary: Competitive

Date: Oct 14, 2026

**Job description**
-------------------

Requisition ID: 1676419

At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.

  

**JOB DESCRIPTION | AI & DATA TECH CONSULTING**

**AI Strategy & Go-To-Market**

Career Family: AIA – AI Strategy & GTM · Pursuits, RFPs & Offering Development

**LEVEL**

**Senior/Manager**

**EXPERIENCE**

**8–12 years**

**LOCATION**

**EY GDS · Hybrid**

**ORIENTATION**

**Strategy-led**

**THE OPPORTUNITY**
===================

  

We are seeking a strategic Manager to join our AI & Data Tech Consulting team, focused on shaping how clients adopt Agentic AI and GenAI — and how the firm takes its AI offerings to market. The ideal candidate brings a blend of AI product strategy, solution positioning, and pursuit leadership, with enough technical fluency to credibly translate AI capabilities into business value, without being a hands-on builder.

You will work closely with account leaders, solution architects, C-suite stakeholders, and alliance partners to win and shape AI programs — owning the narrative from opportunity qualification and RFP response through solution storyboarding, commercial framing, and client orals.

**WHERE YOUR TIME GOES**

**40%**

**RFPs, Proposals & Pursuits**

Win themes, solution storyline, client orals

**30%**

**Go-To-Market & Offerings**

Positioning, enablement collateral, alliances

**30%**

**AI Strategy & Advisory**

Roadmaps, business cases, operating models

**YOUR KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**
=============================

**AI Strategy & Value Advisory**
--------------------------------

* Partner with client leadership and Operating Partners to define AI / Agentic AI vision, use-case portfolios, and adoption roadmaps.

* Build use-case prioritization frameworks (value vs. feasibility vs. risk) and translate them into phased roadmaps (discovery MVP scale).

* Develop business cases with ROI, cost-to-serve, and value-realization metrics that leadership can fund against.

* Frame AI operating models — CoE design, governance, Responsible AI guardrails, and human-in-the-loop controls.

* Knowledge of business process transformation and industry value chains (Health, FS, Consumer, Industrials) would be an added advantage.

**Go-To-Market & Offering Development**
---------------------------------------

* Shape and package AI offerings, accelerators, and assets into market-ready propositions — positioning, messaging, pricing logic, and differentiation.

* Build sales enablement collateral: pitch decks, solution one-pagers, executive pagers, demo storylines, case studies, and battle cards.

* Conduct market, competitive, and analyst research (vendors, hyperscalers, AI-native startups) to inform build / buy / partner decisions and offering roadmaps.

* Work with alliance partners (Microsoft, AWS, Google, ServiceNow, Salesforce, etc.) on joint GTM motions, co-sell plays, and partner-funded programs.

* Track adoption and pipeline KPIs for offerings and feed market signals back into the offering roadmap.

**RFPs, Proposals & Pursuits**
------------------------------

* Lead end-to-end RFP / RFI / RFQ responses for AI and data programs — bid / no-bid qualification, win themes, solution storyline, and response orchestration.

* Translate client requirements into a crisp solution narrative, scope, delivery approach, staffing model, and commercial construct, in collaboration with architects and delivery leads.

* Own proposal quality — compliance matrices, executive summaries, value articulation, risk and assumption logs.

* Prepare and lead client orals, executive workshops, and proof-of-value storyboards; coach pursuit teams on messaging.

* Maintain a reusable pursuit library of proposal content, case studies, and credentials.

**AI Fluency (Conversational, Not Hands-On)**
---------------------------------------------

* Working understanding of LLMs, RAG, Agentic AI frameworks, AI evaluation & observability, and LLMOps — enough to engage architects and challenge solutions credibly.

* Awareness of AI risk, regulation, and governance (EU AI Act, NIST AI RMF, ISO 42001) and how they shape client buying decisions.

* Familiarity with cloud AI platforms (Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, Google Vertex AI) and enterprise data platforms (Databricks, Snowflake) at a solution level.

* Comfort with AI productivity tools to accelerate research, content, and proposal creation.

**Business Development & Client Management**
--------------------------------------------

* Work closely with account leaders to identify, qualify, and shape opportunities and build tailored value propositions for strategic accounts.

* Build trusted relationships with client CXOs, product owners, and transformation leaders.

* Represent the firm at analyst briefings, industry forums, webinars, and thought-leadership platforms; author POVs, whitepapers, and blogs.

**Team Leadership & Collaboration**
-----------------------------------

* Lead and mentor a small team of strategy consultants and pursuit analysts.

* Orchestrate collaboration across solution architects, delivery, sector specialists, alliances, legal, and pricing teams.

* Drive knowledge sharing, offering playbooks, and capability-building across the practice.

**SKILLS AND ATTRIBUTES**
=========================

**Educational Background**
--------------------------

* MBA / PGDM in Strategy, Marketing, or Business Management from a premier institute. Engineering or quantitative undergraduate background preferred.

**Professional Experience**
---------------------------

* 8–12 years of experience across AI / data product management, strategy consulting, solution / pre-sales, or GTM roles.

* Proven track record of shaping and winning AI, GenAI, or data-driven transformation deals, or of taking AI products from strategy to launch and adoption.

* Experience building offerings, roadmaps, business cases, and executive-facing collateral for enterprise clients.

* Exposure to market research, competitive benchmarking, startup / vendor evaluation, or innovation programs is a strong plus.

**Soft Skills**
---------------

* Exceptional storytelling and executive presence — able to turn complex AI concepts into a compelling, simple business narrative.

* Strong structured thinking and problem-solving; comfortable working under pursuit deadlines.

* Excellent written communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills, especially with C-suite executives.

* Influencing without authority across large, matrixed pursuit teams.

**Preferred Certifications**
----------------------------

* GenAI / AI strategy certifications (Microsoft, AWS, Google, Coursera, ISB / IIM executive programs, etc.)

* Product management or agile certifications (SAFe POPM / PM, Pragmatic, CSPO), Design Thinking.

* APMP (proposal management) certification is a plus.

**IDEAL PROFILE**
=================

**You will thrive here if you…**

* Have taken AI / data products from 0 1 and know what drives adoption

* Love building the story, the business case, and the winning proposal

* Can hold your own with architects — and simplify for the CXO

* Have run market scans, vendor evaluations, or innovation programs

**This role is not…**

* A hands-on engineering or model-building role

* Writing production code, data pipelines, or agent frameworks

* Pure delivery / project management

* A back-office bid-desk formatting role

**WHY JOIN US**
===============

  

* Shape how leading global enterprises adopt AI — and how the firm wins in the AI market.

* Work at the intersection of strategy, technology, and growth, with direct visibility to account and practice leadership.

* Collaborate with a team of AI experts, solution architects, and industry specialists in a highly entrepreneurial environment.

**WHAT WE OFFER**
=================

  

EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.

* **Continuous learning** — You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.

* **Success as defined by you** — We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.

* **Transformative leadership** — We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.

* **Diverse and inclusive culture** — You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

**EY | Building a better working world**

  

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.
