description:
OpenGov is the leader in AI and ERP solutions for local and state governments in the U.S. More than 2,000 cities, counties, state agencies, school districts, and special districts rely on the OpenGov Public Service Platform to operate efficiently, adapt to change, and strengthen the public trust. Category-leading products include enterprise asset management, procurement and contract management, accounting and budgeting, billing and revenue management, permitting and licensing, and transparency and open data. These solutions come together in the OpenGov ERP, allowing public sector organizations to focus on priorities and deliver maximum ROI with every dollar and decision in sync. Learn about OpenGov’s mission to power more effective and accountable government and the vision of high-performance government for every community at OpenGov.com.

**Job Summary:**
----------------

The SDR Manager, based in Pune, leads a team of Sales Development Representatives dedicated to generating pipeline for OpenGov's US go-to-market team. This role owns the performance, coaching, and day to day execution of the Pune SDR team, ensuring consistent, high quality outbound activity into the US public sector market. You'll report to a US-based Director of Sales Development and act as the connective tissue between the Pune team and US leadership, translating strategy into daily execution and results.

**Responsibilities:**
---------------------

* Manage and coach a team of 6 SDRs so they consistently hit pipeline and activity targets
* Monitor individual and team metrics (calls, emails, meetings booked, pipeline generated) and run regular one on one meetings and performance reviews
* Translate US GTM strategy and territory priorities from US leadership into daily and weekly execution plans for the Pune team
* Build onboarding, ramp plans, and ongoing skill development programs so new SDRs reach full productivity quickly
* Partner closely with the US-based Director of Sales Development and US Account Executives to align on lead quality, handoff process, and feedback loops
* Ensure the team uses Salesforce, Outreach, and LinkedIn effectively, and maintain clean, accurate reporting for leadership
* Manage a team working US-aligned hours from Pune, including shift scheduling and coverage planning
* Deliver regular updates to US leadership on team performance, pipeline health, and areas for improvement
* Build a high energy, competitive, and supportive team culture that keeps SDRs engaged and motivated

**Requirements and Preferred Experience:**
------------------------------------------

* 7+ years of experience in sales development or outbound sales, including a proven track record managing SDR or BDR teams
* Experience managing a team that supports a US market or works US-aligned hours
* Strong coaching skills, with a track record of developing reps and improving individual performance
* Comfortable working US-aligned hours from Pune
* Excellent spoken and written English, with the ability to communicate effectively with US-based leadership and stakeholders
* A data driven approach to managing pipeline and activity metrics, with fluency in Salesforce and sales engagement tools (Outreach or similar)
* Genuinely curious about technology and its role in government, with the ability to translate that curiosity into team level coaching
* Background in B2B, SaaS, BPO, or government focused sales organizations is a strong plus
* Bachelor's degree preferred

**Why OpenGov?**
================

**A Mission That Matters.**

At OpenGov, public service is personal. We are passionate about our mission to power more effective and accountable government. Government that operates efficiently, adapts to change, and strengthens public trust. Some people say this is boring. We think it’s the core of our democracy.

**Opportunity to Innovate**

The next great wave of innovation is unfolding with AI, and it will impact everything—from the way we work to the way governments interact with their residents. Join a trusted team with the passion, technology, and expertise to drive innovation and bring AI to local government. We’ve touched 2,000 communities so far, and we’re just getting started.

**A Team of Passionate, Driven People**

This isn’t your typical 9-to-5 job; we operate in a fast-paced, results-driven environment where impact matters more than simply clocking in and out. Our global team of 800+ employees is united in our commitment to challenge the status quo. OpenGov is headquartered in San Francisco and has offices in Atlanta, Boston, Chicago, Dubuque, Dallas, and Pune.

**A Place to Make Your Mark**

We pride ourselves on our performance-based culture, where every employee is encouraged to jump in head-first and take action to help us improve. If you have a great idea, we want to hear it. Excellent performance is recognized and rewarded, and we love to promote from within.

title: Senior Enterprise Sales Lead
description:
**Senior Enterprise Sales Lead**

**The role:**

Fonazo is hiring a Senior Enterprise Sales Lead to open, close, and expand accounts with the largest companies in every market Fonazo serves.

Fonazo is an AI Voice Agent Builder. A business describes the agent it needs and launches it in about two minutes. Every agent carries its own phone number, speaks 76 languages with mid-call switching, reads emotion, sends WhatsApp and SMS in real time, connects to CRM and calendar systems, and reports every call through Fonazo Analytics. The Global Compliance Engine is live in India, the US, the UK, Germany, and France. Pricing is published in INR, USD, EUR, and GBP.

The mandate has two halves. First, win the top companies in BFSI, healthcare, real estate, logistics, ecommerce, hospitality, and government. Second, take Fonazo everywhere inside them: one domain goes live, is handed to the delivery team with a complete brief, and the next domain in the same account opens.

Reports to - Founder and CEO

Base - Pune, India, with a global territory

Type - Full time

Experience - 6+ years closing enterprise software deals

Markets - India, UAE, US, UK, France, Germany, Spain, Italy

**What the role owns:**

* The full enterprise cycle: target list, C-suite outreach, discovery, live demo, commercial proposal, security and compliance review, negotiation, signature.
* Direct relationships with CEOs, CFOs, COOs, CIOs, and heads of customer operations at the top companies in each vertical.
* A cost-avoidance business case for every deal, built on the buyer's own call volumes, staffing cost, and conversion numbers.
* Live demos where an agent is built in front of the buyer in two minutes, in the buyer's language, for the buyer's use case.
* Compliance conversations with legal, risk, and procurement teams, presenting the controls Fonazo enforces in each country.
* Account expansion from the first domain to every domain where a phone call happens.
* A clean, accurate pipeline and forecast in the CRM, reviewed weekly with the CEO.
* Market feedback to product: what enterprises ask for, what blocks deals, what competitors quote.

**The handover model:**

Every account follows the same five steps, and the seller owns the first, second, and fifth.

1. Land. Close one domain with a named executive sponsor, for example collections, lead qualification, appointment booking, or customer support.

2. Hand over. Deliver a complete brief to the Forward Deployed Engineering team within 48 hours of signature: use case, call flows, languages, integrations required, compliance scope, success metrics, and stakeholder map.

3. Go live. The delivery team deploys. The seller stays on the executive relationship and out of the build.

4. Prove. Fonazo Analytics produces the results the sponsor committed to internally.

5. Expand. Take those results to the next domain owner in the same company and repeat from step one.

A handover is complete when the delivery team can start work without a single clarifying question to the customer.

**What the candidate brings:**

* 6+ years closing enterprise software or infrastructure deals, with a documented record against quota.
* Personal experience selling to C-suite buyers in at least one of BFSI, healthcare, telecom, BPO, or large-scale consumer operations.
* Experience in a contact centre, conversational AI, CPaaS, CCaaS, or voice technology sale is a strong advantage.
* Proof of land and expand: at least two accounts grown from one business unit to several.
* Comfort in regulated sales cycles involving information security reviews, data protection addenda, and procurement.
* Financial fluency to build and defend an ROI model in front of a CFO.
* Written and spoken English at boardroom standard. Hindi, Arabic, German, French, Spanish, or Italian is an advantage.
* An existing network of enterprise decision makers in at least one Fonazo market.

**What success looks like:**

Timeframe - Outcome

30 days - Product mastery, a live demo delivered unaided, and a named target list of 50 enterprise accounts

90 days - 10 executive-level opportunities in active evaluation and the first enterprise contract signed

180 days - First account expanded into a second domain, with a repeatable handover brief used by the delivery team

12 months - A portfolio of multi-domain enterprise accounts across at least two countries

**Why this role:**

* A product that demos itself: the buyer watches a working agent appear in two minutes.
* Published pricing in four currencies that wins on cost in every market.
* Compliance controls already live in five countries, which shortens legal review.
* Direct line to the founder, with authority to shape enterprise pricing, packaging, and partnerships.
* Fixed pay plus uncapped commission, with accelerators on multi-domain expansion.

Pay: ₹30,000.00 - ₹200,000.00 per month

Job Description:

  

**About Us**

KOHLER® was founded in 1873 and is headquartered in Kohler, Wisconsin, USA. Kohler Co. is one of America’s oldest and largest privately held companies. Kohler Group has multiple manufacturing locations worldwide and is a global leader in the manufacture of kitchen and bath products; decorative, and owner/operator of two of the world’s finest five-star hospitality and golf resort destinations in Kohler, and St Andrews, Scotland. Kohler has been consistent in setting new standards in design, craftsmanship and innovation.

  

**Why Work at Kohler Co.?**

Beyond the competitive benefits and compensation, Kohler proudly offers a rich culture, steeped in creativity and a commitment to our associates and communities. We invite you to learn more about our culture and company at www.kohlercompany.com

It is Kohler’s policy to recruit, hire, and promote qualified personnel in all job classifications without regard to race, creed, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, national origin, disability or veteran status. Kohler Co. is an equal opportunity/affirmative action employer.

**Kohler India is certified as a Great Place To Work Organization. This certification is an endorsement of the culture and values we live by - every day.**

  

**Position Description**

**Position Title**

Executive – Supply Chain

  

**Department**

Ops & Services

  

**Division**

Kohler India Technical Center, Pune

  

**Grade**

  

**Reporting to**

Deputy Manager – Supply Chain

**About the Position:**

  

This role is designed for a hands-on SAP SD end-user expert who plays a critical role in ensuring seamless Order-to-Cash execution, EDI transaction integrity, and high-quality master and transactional data. The position acts as a functional backbone between business users, customers, logistics partners, and IT, ensuring stable operations, rapid issue resolution, and continuous improvement across SD and EDI processes.

The incumbent will be expected to own SAP SD transactions end to end, manage EDI monitoring and exception handling, and apply strong supply chain context to drive accuracy, compliance, and customer experience.

**Roles and Responsibilities:**

SAP SD – End User Ownership

* Act as a power user and functional expert for SAP SD covering key Order-to-Cash processes, including order creation, order changes, pricing, delivery coordination, billing triggers, and status tracking.
* Execute and validate SD transactions such as sales orders, order blocks, delivery blocks, billing blocks, returns, cancellations, and free-of-charge orders.
* Ensure pricing accuracy, condition records, rebates, and contract compliance within SAP SD.
* Perform root-cause analysis for SD-related errors and inconsistencies and work with IT for permanent fixes.

EDI Operations & Exception Management

* Monitor, analyse, and manage EDI transactions (e.g. orders, acknowledgements, invoices, ASNs) to ensure successful end-to-end processing.
* Identify and resolve EDI failures related to master data, pricing, quantities, scheduling, or partner setup.
* Act as the first-level functional owner for EDI exception queues, coordinating with customers, 3PLs, and IT teams.

Data Quality & Governance

* Own master data and transactional data accuracy impacting SD and EDI processes (customer master, material master, pricing, routes, partner functions, etc.).
* Support data governance initiatives by ensuring adherence to SOPs, controls, and audit requirements.
* Identify recurring data issues and partner with data governance or IT teams for long-term resolution.

Stakeholder Collaboration & Knowledge Enablement

* Act as a bridge between business users and IT, providing functional clarity on SD and EDI processes.
* Collaborate closely with Global / North America Supply Chain stakeholders on issue resolution and process alignment.
* Create and maintain SOPs, work instructions, and training material for SAP SD and EDI processes.
* Guide and support junior team members, helping build functional depth within the team.
  

**Experience Requirements:**

**Must-Haves:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Business, or related field.

* 3-5 years of experience in order management or supply chain operations with global exposure.

3. Strong working knowledge of Order-to-Cash processes and their integration with logistics and billing.

4. Practical experience in EDI monitoring, exception handling, and partner coordination.

5. Strong understanding of supply chain execution concepts (order fulfilment, logistics, inventory, service levels).

6. High attention to detail with a strong data and control mindset.

**Good to Have:**

* Experience in FMCG, manufacturing, or large-scale supply chain environments.

* Familiarity with automation tools (Power Automate, Winshuttle) and BI reporting (Power BI).

**Organizational Relationships:**

**Reports to Manager – Supply Chain**

* Regular interactions with North America & Global Supply Chain teams.
* Frequent interaction with internal stakeholders including Supply Chain Leadership teams.
  

**Other Details:**

The associate should have the flexibility to work in shifts that may range from 6:30 AM - 3:30 PM or 2:30 PM to 11:30 PM OR in regular India working hours. (Subject to change)

SAP SD,Order Management,IDOCS,Communication Skills,Problem Solving

Junior Executive – After-Sales Support & Supplier Coordination

You will be the person who makes sure an order goes right after the customer says yes: chasing our factories for production and dispatch, and looking after our overseas customers until the goods are delivered and any issue is closed.

Company

India Pack (indiapack.co.in)

Experience - 0–2 years; freshers with strong written English are welcome

Reports to - Co-founder

Working days - Mon–Sat (Sundays Off)

About India Pack

India Pack is a Pune-based B2B packaging sourcing company, now about 10 years old. We supply FIBCs (jumbo bags), PP woven bags, BOPP bags, flexible pouches and container liners from 10+ audited Indian manufacturers to buyers in the UK, Germany, Scandinavia, the USA and the Middle East.

What you will do

**After-sales support (customers)**

* Be the day-to-day contact for international customers once an order is confirmed: order status, dispatch dates, shipping documents.
* Send shipment updates before the customer has to ask, and confirm delivery at their end.
* Share and file order documents: invoice, packing list, bill of lading, test reports and certificates.
* Register every complaint or quality claim the day it arrives. Collect photos, quantities, batch details and usage conditions from the customer.
* Work with the supplier and our technical team to find the cause, agree the corrective action, and keep the customer updated until the claim is closed.
* Follow up after delivery for feedback and pass repeat-order signals to the sales team.

**Supplier coordination (factories)**

* Follow up with our manufacturing partners by phone and email on production schedules, samples, print proofs and dispatch readiness.
* Track each order from purchase order to shipment and keep the order tracker and ERP/CRM up to date.
* Flag delays or spec deviations early, with a revised date and a proposed fix, not just the problem.
* Coordinate pre-shipment inspections and check test reports against the customer's specification.
* Collect supplier documents on time so that shipping paperwork is never the reason for a delay.

**Reporting**

* Maintain the open-orders and open-claims lists and present a short status every week.

Who we are looking for

**Must have**

* A graduate in any stream (B.Com, BBA, B.Sc, BE or a diploma are all fine).
* Clear, polite written English. Most of your day is email with overseas customers.
* Comfortable speaking Hindi on the phone with factory teams.
* Working knowledge of Excel or Google Sheets: filters, sorting, simple formulas.
* A habit of following up without being reminded, and of writing things down.
* Calm with an unhappy customer: you listen, collect the facts, and respond the same day.

**Good to have**

* Exposure to export documentation, Incoterms or freight forwarding.
* A background in packaging, plastics, textiles or any manufacturing environment.
* Experience with an ERP or CRM or a shared helpdesk inbox.
* Gujarati or Marathi for supplier conversations.

What you will get

* Daily, direct work with customers in Europe, the USA and the Middle East from your first month.
* Hands-on training in FIBC and woven packaging products, quality standards and the export process from order to delivery.
* A small team where you work directly with the founders and your work is visible.
* A growth path to Account Manager, owning a set of customers and suppliers end to end.

description:

**Permanent \- Full Time**

  

**About Us:**  

  

Cyncly is a global technology powerhouse with 2,400\+ employees and 70,000\+ customers across 100\+ countries. Cyncly transforms the way customizable products and spaces are imagined, designed, sold, managed and made. Our end\-to\-end software solutions connect professional designers, retailers and manufacturers to the world's largest repository of product content. Today, our business spans across the Kitchen \& Bath, Furniture, Window, Glass \& Door, and Flooring industries with operations in North \& South America, Europe, Asia Pacific and Africa.


Cyncly brings over 30 years of experience to deliver more value for our customers through an expanded portfolio of end\-to\-end solutions. Our global presence allows us to provide world\-class support and sales with a local touch, providing the best possible customer experience.


Cyncly is now embarking on an exciting journey as we continue to expand through strong organic growth and complementary acquisitions, backed by leading growth private equity firms specialised in technology.  

  

  

  

**About The Role:**

The Sell Director is one of the most senior leaders in the Customer Experience organisation, accountable for the full performance of the Sell domain and for outcomes that roll up to the overall CX organisation: CSAT, SLA performance and Cost of Support.


This role owns the operating model, people decisions, quality standards, KPI performance and transformation agenda for the Sell domain. A core part of the role is leading the domain Subject Matter Experts, who preserve tacit product knowledge and turn it into practical training, documented knowledge and AI\-ready content used by internal teams, the BPO, Quality \& Training, Systems \& Analysis and AI\-enabled support.  

  



**Main Responsibilities:**

* Own CSAT, SLA and Cost of Support outcomes for the Sell domain, with clear reporting to CX Leadership.
* Own the operational KPIs that drive those outcomes: First Reply, Next Reply, First Contact Resolution, Reopen Rate and Abandoned Call performance.
* Own hiring, promotion, performance management and termination decisions across the domain, within company and HR policy.
* Ensure support quality is maintained through clear standards, coaching, knowledge use, escalation handling and customer communication.
* Lead the domain SMEs as a strategic knowledge capability: capture tacit product knowledge, convert it into training, documented guidance and AI\-usable content, and keep that knowledge current.
* Use SME insight to spot product knowledge gaps, support process issues, training needs and AI answer\-quality gaps, then drive fixes with Quality \& Training and Systems \& Analysis.
* Drive AI adoption, automation and self\-service that reduce unnecessary human touch and Cost of Support while maintaining or improving customer outcomes.
* Run the domain operating rhythm across performance review, KPI analysis, risk/action tracking, escalation management and continuous improvement.
* Partner with BPO Management, Quality \& Training, Systems \& Analysis, Product, Engineering and Commercial teams to remove blockers and improve execution.
* Provide concise, evidence\-based updates to the SVP of CX and CX Leadership, including risks, root causes, corrective actions and progress against commitments.

**SME, Knowledge and AI Accountability**

The Director is accountable for making SME knowledge operational: not only answering difficult questions, but improving the whole support model by raising capability, reducing repeat issues and making knowledge reusable across teams and AI.


* Prioritise SME work based on customer impact, ticket demand, product complexity, BPO readiness and AI adoption opportunities.
* Ensure SME outputs flow into training, knowledge articles, troubleshooting guides, QA calibration, macros, escalation logic and AI knowledge sources.
Create a simple governance rhythm for SME output, including knowledge gaps, training needs, AI content improvements and measurable impact on CSAT, SLA, FCR, reopens and cost. This may look like following the KCS standard, or other such framework.  
* 

**Required Skills and Experience:**

**Experience**

* Extensive leadership experience in customer experience, customer support, contact\-centre operations or comparable service delivery environments.
* Equivalent experience is valued where the individual has demonstrated ownership of large\-scale operational outcomes, multi\-level teams, financial performance, customer experience quality and specialist knowledge\-management capability.
* Proven ownership of CSAT, SLA, Cost of Support and related operational KPIs in a complex support environment.
* Strong operational command of First Reply, Next Reply, FCR, Reopen Rate, Abandoned Call and the drivers behind those measures.
* Experience leading managers, specialists and distributed support teams, including significant people\-decision accountability.
* Ability to convert deep product expertise into scalable training, knowledge, quality standards and AI\-ready support content through SMEs or similar specialist teams.
* Strong financial and productivity discipline, with the ability to connect workforce, process, tooling and AI adoption decisions to cost outcomes.
* High confidence using data to diagnose performance, explain root causes, make trade\-offs and drive action.
* Executive\-level communication skills, with concise reporting of performance, risk, decisions and corrective actions.

**Preferred but not required**

* Experience leading a product\-aligned support domain similar in scale or complexity to Sell.
* Experience in a global, matrixed CX organisation with centralised quality, systems, analytics, SME and BPO support functions.
Experience with Zendesk, CCaaS, workforce management, knowledge platforms, AI\-enabled support tooling or major cost\-to\-serve transformation.  
* 

  

**Working For Us:**  

  

At Cyncly, we call our team OneCyncly, a reflection of how we work together as one, united by our purpose: powering businesses that bring spaces to life. Our strength comes from our diversity of experiences, perspectives, and skills \- and we thrive when we work together with openness, trust, and respect.


Here, you’ll join a group of colleagues who take ownership, solve problems, and focus on making an impact. We embrace curiosity, welcome new ideas, and see mistakes as opportunities to learn. You’ll have the freedom to work flexibly and autonomously, supported by teammates and leaders who are committed to your growth.


We celebrate the different ways people contribute and encourage everyone \- from every background \- to bring their authentic self to work. Because when we collaborate, challenge each other, and share what we know, we build something better together.


If you want to work in a place where your ideas matter, your growth is valued, and your work shapes the spaces people live, work, and play in \- come join us.

title: Program Governance Manager – Customer Experience
description:
**Location: Pune, India (Hybrid)**  

**Permanent \- Full Time**

  

**About Us:**  

  

Cyncly is a global technology powerhouse with 2,400\+ employees and 70,000\+ customers across 100\+ countries. Cyncly transforms the way customizable products and spaces are imagined, designed, sold, managed and made. Our end\-to\-end software solutions connect professional designers, retailers and manufacturers to the world's largest repository of product content. Today, our business spans across the Kitchen \& Bath, Furniture, Window, Glass \& Door, and Flooring industries with operations in North \& South America, Europe, Asia Pacific and Africa.


Cyncly brings over 30 years of experience to deliver more value for our customers through an expanded portfolio of end\-to\-end solutions. Our global presence allows us to provide world\-class support and sales with a local touch, providing the best possible customer experience.


Cyncly is now embarking on an exciting journey as we continue to expand through strong organic growth and complementary acquisitions, backed by leading growth private equity firms specialised in technology.  

  

  

  

**About The Role:**

The Program Governance Manager – Customer Experience is a relationship and governance role, not a target\-carrying operations role. You own the mechanism that makes the partnership work: the reporting, cadence, coordination, and health of the relationship. The delivery targets themselves (service levels, quality and cost) sit with the operational leaders. Your job is to make sure the partner always knows what is expected and where they stand, and that Cyncly leaders always have an accurate, current picture of the performance outputs of the BPO. Leaders such as our CX Domain Directors, SVP CX, CCO, and wider executive members.


We work with a strategic outsourcing (BPO) partner to deliver customer support across multiple domains, product lines, and regions. This role is the single point of contact between Cyncly and that partner.


You will keep a clear, consistent, and trusted view of how the relationship is performing, so that everyone on both sides always knows where things stand. You will stand the partnership up through transition and go\-live and then run the ongoing relationship day to day.


The role is designed to expand as trust is earned: at the start, you stand up the mechanism, get reporting flowing, establish the governance cadence and make the transition land cleanly; as the relationship settles, you move from reactive to proactive by anticipating risks, championing change and building a genuine joint team; and in the mature relationship, you become a true partnership steward, keeping leadership sponsorship sharp and the relationship healthy and honest. The through\-line is a move from running the reporting to making the partnership succeed.  

  



**Main Responsibilities:**

* Act as the single point of contact for Cyncly's outsourcing partner across operational, reporting and relationship matters.
* Build and run the governance rhythm, including performance reporting, review meetings, quarterly business reviews, agendas, minutes, and action tracking.
* Produce clear, accurate performance reporting and maintain one consistent view of how the partnership is performing, creating a single trusted version rather than different stories across the business.
* Route and coordinate escalations to the right owners and drive them through to resolution.
* Coordinate capacity, workforce planning, and forecasting between partner and internal teams.
* Track risks, actions, issues and decisions, and surface emerging risks early.
* Lead Cyncly's side of the transition and go\-live, partnering closely with the provider's transition team, then carrying the relationship into a steady state.
Champion continuous improvement and a genuine one\-team relationship built on trust and honest communication rather than adversarial vendor management.  
* 

**Required Skills and Experience:**

**Experience**

* Typically 8 to 14 years of experience in customer experience, contact center or BPO delivery, including experience managing or governing an outsourced engagement from the client side.
* Equivalent experience is valued; formal project, programme or partnership\-management credentials are welcomed where they support the role, but are not the primary requirement.
* Strong governance, project and relationship\-management discipline across cadence, reporting, risk tracking and stakeholder communication.

* Strong operational command of First Reply, Next Reply, FCR, Reopen Rate, Abandoned Call and the drivers behind those measures.
* Experience leading managers, specialists and distributed support teams, including significant people\-decision accountability.
* Ability to convert deep product expertise into scalable training, knowledge, quality standards and AI\-ready support content through SMEs or similar specialist teams.
* Strong financial and productivity discipline, with the ability to connect workforce, process, tooling and AI adoption decisions to cost outcomes.
* High confidence using data to diagnose performance, explain root causes, make trade\-offs and drive action.

**Preferred but not required**

\* Meeting Scheduled

\* Converted

\* Make outbound calls.

\* Speak with prospects.

\* Follow up with previous leads.

\* Update CRM after every interaction.

\*\*End of Day\*\*

\* Complete pending follow\-ups.

\* Update CRM.

title: Value Realization Manager
description:
**Who are we?**


Checkmarx is the leader in application security and ensures that enterprises worldwide can secure their application development from code to cloud. Our consolidated platform and services address the needs of enterprises by improving security and reducing TCO, while simultaneously building trust between AppSec, developers, and CISOs. At Checkmarx, we believe it’s not just about *finding risk but* *remediating* it across the entire application footprint and software supply chain with one seamless process for all relevant stakeholders.


We are honored to serve more than 1,800 customers, which includes 40 percent of all Fortune 100 companies, including Siemens, Airbus, Salesforce, Stellantis, Adidas, Wal\-Mart, and Sanofi.

**About the Role**


We're looking for a \*\*Value Realization Manager\*\* to join our Revenue Operations team. This is a newly created role focused on one clear mission: making sure the GTM technology we've invested in—Clari, Outreach, PG:AI, ZoomInfo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, and similar GTM platforms—actually delivers the business outcomes it was purchased for.


You'll sit at the intersection of RevOps, Sales Enablement, and Vendor Management. Rather than just administering tools, you'll own the \*value\* they generate: adoption, ROI, workflow efficiency, and measurable impact on pipeline and revenue. If you've spent time as a customer success manager on the vendor side of GTM tech and are ready to apply that customer success discipline internally, this role is built for you.

 **What You'll Do**

* Own the end\-to\-end value realization strategy for our core GTM tech stack (Clari, Outreach, PG:AI, ZoomInfo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, and call recorder tools such as Kaia or Clari Copilot)
* Define and track adoption metrics, usage benchmarks, and ROI models for each platform; report regularly to RevOps and Sales leadership
* Partner with Sales, Sales Enablement, Business Application, and IT teams to ensure tools are configured, integrated, and used the way they were intended
* Identify underutilized features or workflows and drive targeted enablement to close the gap
* Act as the internal "CSM" for each vendor relationship—running regular business reviews, escalating issues, and holding vendors accountable to their own value promises
* Build and maintain a value realization scorecard/dashboard that ties tool usage to pipeline, forecast accuracy, and rep productivity outcomes
* Lead onboarding and change management for new tool rollouts or major feature releases
* Gather qualitative and quantitative feedback from sales reps and managers to continuously improve stack ROI
* Serve as the primary point of contact for renewal and expansion conversations, providing usage data and value evidence to inform commercial decisions

  

Requirements:
  

* 3\+ years of experience in customer success, revenue operations, sales enablement, or a related GTM function
* Direct hands\-on experience with at least 2 of the following: Call Recorder Tool, Clari, Outreach, ZoomInfo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator
* Strong communication and presentation skills—comfortable in front of sales reps, frontline managers, and executive leadership alike
* Strong analytical skills—comfortable building dashboards, interpreting usage data, and translating numbers into a business narrative
* Excellent stakeholder management skills; able to influence sales leaders and reps without direct authority

**Strongly Preferred:**

* Prior experience as a \*\*Customer Success Manager at Clari, Outreach, ZoomInfo, or LinkedIn—you know these tools from the vendor side and understand how to extract maximum value from them
* Familiarity with GTM tech stack architecture and how these tools integrate with each other and with Salesforce/HubSpot
